Need help on the weekend? Our team will be available by phone during these hours to assist you.

- Saturday phone support: 9 am – 1 pm (from 30 November)
- Live chat remains available around the clock, seven days a week
- Weekday phone support hours are unchanged

We hope this makes it even easier to get the help you need, whenever you need it.
